name: Kincrome apprentice tool kit free bonus
summary: Registered apprentices who buy a Kincrome apprentice tool kit can redeem a free bonus tool, storage or accessory.
key: Every Kincrome Apprentice Tool Kit comes with a free bonus for registered apprentices.
how: Choose a kit, register online and claim the bonus on the redemption page.
catches: The bonus depends on the kit bought; you must buy a kit first.

source.label: Kincrome: Tools for Life apprentice program

evidence.quote: Every Kincrome Apprentice Tool Kit comes with a free bonus via redemption for registered apprentices.
